text.TL: Ang aming teritoryo ay naitatag na.

text.EN: We have enough people to stop surviving from one night to the next. Pick a place, mark it as ours, and we can start building something that lasts.
text.TL: We have enough people to stop surviving from one night to the next. Pick a place, mark it as ours, and we can simulan gusali something that lasts.

text.EN: Then let us find ground worth defending. I will help turn it into home.
text.TL: Then let us find ground worth defending. I will tulong turn it into home.
